title: SearchFabricRequest
description: search.fabric-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/query (or the query string of GET /api/v1/query, scopes comma-separated), capability search.fabric.query. One search over several scopes, routed the cheapest way that answers (plan 2026-10-28 §4.5). network: Search's own index, permission-aware exactly as search.query.run; mine: the caller's own private documents (a signed-in person, or a service with X-OV-Subject); web: OpenVibe's open index first, then paid providers in a ladder, each result keeping its provider, date and URL. Providers never receive an account identifier. A scope the caller may not use (mine without a person; web's paid providers for an anonymous caller, who gets cached and open-index results only) is reported in route.explain, never an error. The other scopes are facets of the same indexes and are accepted for forward compatibility; v1 answers them as network results filtered by kind.

scopes.description: Where to look; results are grouped by scope. Default: network.

filters.description: Narrow the network and mine scopes (never widen what the caller may see).

site.description: web: results from this host only.

freshness.description: How recent results must be, where the source dates them.

depth.description: quick: indexes and caches only (no paid provider); standard: the ladder until a step answers; deep: every step, merged.

answer.description: Ask for a short cited answer written by AI from the results. Never without citations; labelled AI. A deployment may decline (answer: null, with the reason in route.explain).

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page (network and mine only).
